# Stream Deck, VTube Studio, Voicemod, Wave Link, Lumia, MIDI and T.I.T.S.

C# methods for a **Run C# code** step. See [C# methods](index.md) for how to use them.

## StreamDeckSetTitle

Changes the text on a Stream Deck key. Find the key by the Button ID you set on it in Stream Deck. Add a state (0 or 1) to change only that state's title.

```csharp
void StreamDeckSetTitle(string buttonId, string title)
void StreamDeckSetTitle(string buttonId, string title, int state)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.StreamDeckSetTitle("deaths", "Deaths: 3");
```

## StreamDeckSetValue

Changes the value shown on a Stream Deck key or dial, found by its Button ID.

```csharp
void StreamDeckSetValue(string buttonId, string value)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.StreamDeckSetValue("volume-dial", "75");
```

## StreamDeckSetState

Switches a two-state Stream Deck key to state 0 or state 1, found by its Button ID.

```csharp
void StreamDeckSetState(string buttonId, int state)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.StreamDeckSetState("mic-key", 1);
```

## StreamDeckToggleState

Flips a two-state Stream Deck key to its other state, found by its Button ID.

```csharp
void StreamDeckToggleState(string buttonId)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.StreamDeckToggleState("mic-key");
```

## StreamDeckShowAlert


**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**


## StreamDeckShowOk

```csharp
void StreamDeckShowOk(string buttonId)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.StreamDeckShowOk("start-stream");
```

## StreamDeckSetBackgroundColor

Fills a Stream Deck key with one colour, like "#FF0000" or "red". Add a state (0 or 1) to colour only that state.

```csharp
void StreamDeckSetBackgroundColor(string buttonId, string color)
void StreamDeckSetBackgroundColor(string buttonId, string color, int state)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.StreamDeckSetBackgroundColor("live-key", "#FF0000");
```

## StreamDeckSetBackgroundLocal

Shows a picture file from your computer on a Stream Deck key. Add a state (0 or 1) to change only that state. The colour setting is ignored in Cuebot.

```csharp
void StreamDeckSetBackgroundLocal(string buttonId, string imageFile)
void StreamDeckSetBackgroundLocal(string buttonId, string imageFile, int state)
void StreamDeckSetBackgroundLocal(string buttonId, string imageFile, string color)
void StreamDeckSetBackgroundLocal(string buttonId, string imageFile, string color, int state)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.StreamDeckSetBackgroundLocal("live-key", @"C:\Stream\Icons\live.png");
```

## StreamDeckSetBackgroundUrl

Shows a picture from a web link on a Stream Deck key. Add a state (0 or 1) to change only that state. The colour setting is ignored in Cuebot.

```csharp
void StreamDeckSetBackgroundUrl(string buttonId, string imageUrl)
void StreamDeckSetBackgroundUrl(string buttonId, string imageUrl, int state)
void StreamDeckSetBackgroundUrl(string buttonId, string imageUrl, string color)
void StreamDeckSetBackgroundUrl(string buttonId, string imageUrl, string color, int state)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.StreamDeckSetBackgroundUrl("live-key", "https://example.com/live.png");
```

## VTubeStudioTriggerHotkeyById

Presses a VTube Studio hotkey. Cuebot finds it by its id or by its name.

```csharp
bool VTubeStudioTriggerHotkeyById(string hotkeyId)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when it failed (a warning goes to the log).

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.VTubeStudioTriggerHotkeyById("a1b2c3d4");
CPH.LogInfo($"Hotkey pressed: {ok}");
```

## VTubeStudioTriggerHotkeyByName

Presses a VTube Studio hotkey by its name, like "Wave". An id works too.

```csharp
bool VTubeStudioTriggerHotkeyByName(string hotkeyName)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when it failed (a warning goes to the log).

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.VTubeStudioTriggerHotkeyByName("Wave");
CPH.LogInfo($"Hotkey pressed: {ok}");
```

## VTubeStudioLoadModelById

Loads a different VTube Studio model. Cuebot finds it by its id or by its name.

```csharp
bool VTubeStudioLoadModelById(string modelId)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when it failed.

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.VTubeStudioLoadModelById("d4e5f6a7");
CPH.LogInfo($"Model loaded: {ok}");
```

## VTubeStudioLoadModelByName

Loads a different VTube Studio model by its name, like "Cat Form". An id works too.

```csharp
bool VTubeStudioLoadModelByName(string modelName)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when it failed.

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.VTubeStudioLoadModelByName("Cat Form");
CPH.LogInfo($"Model loaded: {ok}");
```

## VTubeStudioActivateExpression

Turns on a VTube Studio expression. Give its file name, like "Happy.exp3.json".

```csharp
bool VTubeStudioActivateExpression(string expressionFile)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when it failed.

**Example**

```csharp

```

## VTubeStudioDeactivateExpression

Turns off a VTube Studio expression. Give its file name, like "Happy.exp3.json".

```csharp
bool VTubeStudioDeactivateExpression(string expressionFile)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when it failed.

**Example**


## VTubeStudioGetModelPosition

Asks VTube Studio where your model is: its X and Y position, rotation and size.

```csharp
VTSModelPosition? VTubeStudioGetModelPosition()
```

**Gives back:** The position (PositionX, PositionY, Rotation, Size), or null when VTube Studio did not answer.

**Example**

```csharp
var pos = CPH.VTubeStudioGetModelPosition();
if (pos != null) CPH.LogInfo($"Model at {pos.PositionX}, {pos.PositionY}, size {pos.Size}");
```

## VTubeStudioMoveModel

Moves your VTube Studio model over a number of seconds (0 to 2). With relative true, it moves from where it is now. Leave a value out to keep it as it is.

```csharp
bool VTubeStudioMoveModel(double seconds, bool relative, double? posX = null, double? posY = null, double? rotation = null, double? size = null)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when it failed.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.VTubeStudioMoveModel(0.5, false, 0.0, -0.3);
```

## VTubeStudioColorTintAll

Tints your whole VTube Studio model one colour, like "#FF8800" (add two more digits for see-through). Mix with scene lighting goes from 0 to 1.

```csharp
bool VTubeStudioColorTintAll(string hexColor, double mixWithSceneLighting = 0)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when it failed or the colour was not #RRGGBB.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.VTubeStudioColorTintAll("#FF8800");
```

## VTubeStudioColorTintByNames

Tints only the model parts (art meshes) whose names match exactly. Colour like "#00FF00", scene lighting mix 0 to 1.

```csharp
bool VTubeStudioColorTintByNames(string hexColor, double mixWithSceneLighting, List<string> filterValues)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when it failed or the colour was not #RRGGBB.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.VTubeStudioColorTintByNames("#00FF00", 0, new List<string> { "HairFront", "HairBack" });
```

## VTubeStudioColorTintByNameContains

Tints only the model parts (art meshes) whose names contain one of your words. Colour like "#00FF00", scene lighting mix 0 to 1.

```csharp
bool VTubeStudioColorTintByNameContains(string hexColor, double mixWithSceneLighting, List<string> filterValues)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when it failed or the colour was not #RRGGBB.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.VTubeStudioColorTintByNameContains("#00FF00", 0, new List<string> { "Hair" });
```

## VTubeStudioColorTintByTags

Tints only the model parts (art meshes) whose tags match exactly. Colour like "#0000FF", scene lighting mix 0 to 1.

```csharp
bool VTubeStudioColorTintByTags(string hexColor, double mixWithSceneLighting, List<string> filterValues)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when it failed or the colour was not #RRGGBB.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.VTubeStudioColorTintByTags("#0000FF", 0.5, new List<string> { "clothes" });
```

## VTubeStudioColorTintByTagContains

Tints only the model parts (art meshes) whose tags contain one of your words. Colour like "#0000FF", scene lighting mix 0 to 1.

```csharp
bool VTubeStudioColorTintByTagContains(string hexColor, double mixWithSceneLighting, List<string> filterValues)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when it failed or the colour was not #RRGGBB.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.VTubeStudioColorTintByTagContains("#0000FF", 0.5, new List<string> { "cloth" });
```

## VTubeStudioColorTintByNumber

Tints only the model parts (art meshes) with the numbers you list. Colour like "#FF00FF", scene lighting mix 0 to 1.

```csharp
bool VTubeStudioColorTintByNumber(string hexColor, double mixWithSceneLighting, List<int> artMeshNumbers)
```

## VTubeStudioSendRawRequest

Sends any VTube Studio request by its type name, with its data written as JSON text. For advanced users who know the VTube Studio API.

```csharp
string VTubeStudioSendRawRequest(string requestType, string data)
```

**Gives back:** The answer's data as JSON text, or empty text when it failed.

**Example**

```csharp
string answer = CPH.VTubeStudioSendRawRequest("StatisticsRequest", "");
CPH.LogInfo(answer);
```

## WaveLinkGetInputIdentifier

Finds the id of a Wave Link input (channel) by its name, like "Game". Other Wave Link methods need this id.

```csharp
string WaveLinkGetInputIdentifier(string inputName)
```

**Gives back:** The input's id, or empty text when there is no input with that name.

**Example**

```csharp
string id = CPH.WaveLinkGetInputIdentifier("Game");
CPH.LogInfo($"Game input: {id}");
```

## WaveLinkGetMicrophoneIdentifier

Finds the id of a microphone in Wave Link by its name.

```csharp
string WaveLinkGetMicrophoneIdentifier(string microphoneName)
```

**Gives back:** The microphone's id, or empty text when there is none with that name.

**Example**

```csharp
string mic = CPH.WaveLinkGetMicrophoneIdentifier("Wave:3");
CPH.LogInfo($"Mic id: {mic}");
```

## WaveLinkInputMute

Mutes a Wave Link input in one mixer: "Local" (or "Monitor") for what you hear, "Stream" for what viewers hear.

```csharp
void WaveLinkInputMute(string identifier, string mixer)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

**Example**

```csharp
string id = CPH.WaveLinkGetInputIdentifier("Music");
CPH.WaveLinkInputMute(id, "Stream");
```

## WaveLinkInputUnmute

Unmutes a Wave Link input in one mixer: "Local" (or "Monitor") or "Stream".

```csharp
void WaveLinkInputUnmute(string identifier, string mixer)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

**Example**

```csharp
string id = CPH.WaveLinkGetInputIdentifier("Music");
CPH.WaveLinkInputUnmute(id, "Stream");
```

## WaveLinkInputToggleMute

Flips a Wave Link input between muted and unmuted in one mixer: "Local" (or "Monitor") or "Stream".

```csharp
void WaveLinkInputToggleMute(string identifier, string mixer)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

**Example**

```csharp
string id = CPH.WaveLinkGetInputIdentifier("Music");
CPH.WaveLinkInputToggleMute(id, "Local");
```

## WaveLinkInputSetVolume

Sets a Wave Link input's volume in one mixer, from 0 to 100.

```csharp
void WaveLinkInputSetVolume(string inputIdentifier, string mixer, int volume)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

**Example**

```csharp
string id = CPH.WaveLinkGetInputIdentifier("Music");
CPH.WaveLinkInputSetVolume(id, "Stream", 40);
```

## WaveLinkInputGetVolume

Reads a Wave Link input's volume in one mixer (0 to 100). The input can be given by id or name.

```csharp
long WaveLinkInputGetVolume(string inputIdentifier, string mixer)
```

**Gives back:** The volume as a whole number, or 0 when it is not known.

**Example**

```csharp
long volume = CPH.WaveLinkInputGetVolume("Music", "Stream");
CPH.LogInfo($"Music volume: {volume}");
```

## WaveLinkInputFilterEnable

Turns on one filter (effect) of a Wave Link input. Give the input id and the filter id.

```csharp
void WaveLinkInputFilterEnable(string inputIdentifier, string filterIdentifier)
```

```csharp
string filter = CPH.WaveLinkInputGetFilterIdentifier(input, "Reverb");
CPH.WaveLinkInputFilterEnable(input, filter);
```

## WaveLinkInputFilterDisable

Turns off one filter (effect) of a Wave Link input. Give the input id and the filter id.

```csharp
void WaveLinkInputFilterDisable(string inputIdentifier, string filterIdentifier)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

**Example**

```csharp
string input = CPH.WaveLinkGetInputIdentifier("Mic");
string filter = CPH.WaveLinkInputGetFilterIdentifier(input, "Reverb");
CPH.WaveLinkInputFilterDisable(input, filter);
```

## WaveLinkInputFilterToggle

Flips one filter (effect) of a Wave Link input on or off. Give the input id and the filter id.

```csharp
void WaveLinkInputFilterToggle(string inputIdentifier, string filterIdentifier)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

**Example**

```csharp
string input = CPH.WaveLinkGetInputIdentifier("Mic");
string filter = CPH.WaveLinkInputGetFilterIdentifier(input, "Reverb");
CPH.WaveLinkInputFilterToggle(input, filter);
```

## WaveLinkInputGetFilterIdentifier

Finds the id of a filter (effect) on a Wave Link input by the filter's name.

```csharp
string WaveLinkInputGetFilterIdentifier(string inputIdentifier, string filterName)
```

**Gives back:** The filter's id, or empty text when there is none with that name.

## WaveLinkInputGetFilterState

Checks whether a filter (effect) on a Wave Link input is turned on. The filter can be given by id or name.


## WaveLinkInputFilterBypassBypassed

Skips every filter of a Wave Link input in one mixer ("Local" or "Stream"), so it sounds dry.


```csharp
CPH.WaveLinkInputFilterBypassBypassed(input, "Stream");
```

## WaveLinkInputFilterBypassEnabled

Stops skipping the filters of a Wave Link input in one mixer ("Local" or "Stream"), so they run again.

```csharp
void WaveLinkInputFilterBypassEnabled(string inputIdentifier, string mixer)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

**Example**

```csharp

CPH.WaveLinkInputFilterBypassEnabled(input, "Stream");
```

## WaveLinkInputFilterBypassToggle

Flips filter skipping (bypass) of a Wave Link input on or off in one mixer ("Local" or "Stream").

```csharp
void WaveLinkInputFilterBypassToggle(string inputIdentifier, string mixer)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

**Example**

```csharp
string input = CPH.WaveLinkGetInputIdentifier("Mic");
CPH.WaveLinkInputFilterBypassToggle(input, "Stream");
```

## WaveLinkInputSetFilterBypassEnabled

## WaveLinkInputSetFilterBypassToggle

Same as WaveLinkInputFilterBypassToggle: flips filter skipping of the input in one mixer.

```csharp
void WaveLinkInputSetFilterBypassToggle(string inputIdentifier, string mixer)
```

## WaveLinkMicrophoneSetVolume

Sets a microphone's gain (how loud it picks you up). Wave Link 3 uses percent (0 to 100); older Wave Link uses the microphone's own scale.


**Gives back:** Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

**Example**

```csharp

CPH.WaveLinkMicrophoneSetVolume(mic, 60.0);
```


**Gives back:** The gain as a number, or 0 when it is not known.

**Example**

```csharp

```

## LumiaSetToDefault

Puts your Lumia Stream lights back to their normal (default) look.

```csharp
void LumiaSetToDefault()
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.LumiaSetToDefault();
```

## MidiSendNoteOn

Plays a MIDI note on one of Cuebot's MIDI Out connections, found by its id. Channel 1 to 16, note and velocity 0 to 127. Add a time in milliseconds and true to stop the note after that time.

```csharp
void MidiSendNoteOn(Guid deviceId, int channel, int note, int velocity, int duration = 0, bool sendNoteOff = false)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.MidiSendNoteOn(Guid.Parse("3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e7b-9c1d-2a6f8e0b4c3d"), 1, 60, 100, 500, true);
```

## MidiSendNoteOnByName

Plays a MIDI note on a MIDI Out connection, found by its name. Channel 1 to 16, note and velocity 0 to 127. Add a time in milliseconds and true to stop the note after that time.

```csharp
void MidiSendNoteOnByName(string name, int channel, int note, int velocity, int duration = 0, bool sendNoteOff = false)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.MidiSendNoteOnByName("Lights Controller", 1, 60, 100, 500, true);
```

## MidiSendControlChange

Sends a MIDI control change (like moving a knob) on a MIDI Out connection, found by its id. Channel 1 to 16, controller and value 0 to 127.

```csharp
void MidiSendControlChange(Guid deviceId, int channel, int controller, int value)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.MidiSendControlChange(Guid.Parse("3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e7b-9c1d-2a6f8e0b4c3d"), 1, 7, 100);
```

## MidiSendControlChangeByName

Sends a MIDI control change (like moving a knob) on a MIDI Out connection, found by its name. Channel 1 to 16, controller and value 0 to 127.

```csharp
void MidiSendControlChangeByName(string name, int channel, int controller, int value)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.MidiSendControlChangeByName("Lights Controller", 1, 7, 100);
```

## MidiSendRaw

Sends one raw MIDI message on a MIDI Out connection, found by its id. The command is the message kind, like 0x90 for Note On. For advanced users.

```csharp
void MidiSendRaw(Guid deviceId, int command, int channel, int data1, int data2)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.MidiSendRaw(Guid.Parse("3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e7b-9c1d-2a6f8e0b4c3d"), 0x90, 1, 60, 100);
```

## MidiSendRawByName

Sends one raw MIDI message on a MIDI Out connection, found by its name. The command is the message kind, like 0x90 for Note On or 0xB0 for a control change.

```csharp
void MidiSendRawByName(string name, int command, int channel, int data1, int data2)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.MidiSendRawByName("Lights Controller", 0xB0, 1, 7, 100);
```

## ThrowingSystemThrowItemByName

Throws an item at your model in T.I.T.S., by the item's name. You can set how many times and the seconds between throws.

```csharp
bool ThrowingSystemThrowItemByName(string itemName, double delay = 0.05, int amount = 1)
```

**Gives back:** true when T.I.T.S. threw it, otherwise false.

**Example**

```csharp
bool thrown = CPH.ThrowingSystemThrowItemByName("Tomato", 0.1, 5);
CPH.LogInfo($"Thrown: {thrown}");
```

## ThrowingSystemActivateTriggerByName

Starts a trigger you set up in T.I.T.S., by its name.

```csharp
bool ThrowingSystemActivateTriggerByName(string triggerName)
```

**Gives back:** true when T.I.T.S. accepted it, false when it failed or the name was empty.

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.ThrowingSystemActivateTriggerByName("Rain of Hearts");
CPH.LogInfo($"Trigger started: {ok}");
```
